subject: Newsletters as your 76th signal
body:
Persana blends 100+ data sources into enrichment, and newsletters are the one that carries editorial signal: which publications write about an account, which brands buy space in them, which people were named, and whether the list is rising.

NewsletterFIT derives those with AI from the newsletter ecosystem and serves them over REST ([DOCS_LINK]) and MCP ([MCP_LINK]), as structured records with a source URL and date.

The category is measured in our graph already: Clay 92 articles across 56 publications, Apollo 102 across 88, ZoomInfo 25 across 19, Lusha 5, 6sense 12. Persana appears once, in Topline, in a piece on the GTM tech land grab.

If newsletters are already one of the 100+, one line and I will stop. If not, I can send a sample for a segment you sell, shaped from the same fields.
